author: Minecraft
description: Take on new challenges in the latest Dragon Ball Z DLC Legends update! Discover new fighters like Bardock, Teen Gohan, Gotenks, and Vegito. Battle in new areas and compete in a new Custom Tournament mode for up to 8 players. Continue the Story Mode with 4 new fights and unlock 11 alternate versions of the original characters!
title: Minecraft x Dragon Ball Z - 1.1 Legends Update
